en: The postcard features an illustrated scene of a snow-covered mountain village, with a traditional stone building partially buried in snow. In the foreground, two people are depicted skiing, dressed in early 20th-century winter attire. The background shows high, snowy alpine peaks. The words 'Engadin Pontresina' are prominently displayed, suggesting a winter sports destination.
